Name: Volcano Chest Reset Card
Author: TacNotCat
Description:
[AI-translated] English below, Chinese version further down. [b][size=5]Volcano Chest Reset Card[/size][/b] Opened a Volcano Dungeon chest and got junk? Reset it and roll again — as many times as you like. [b]HOW TO GET ONE[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy it at [b]Mr. Qi's walnut room[/b]: [b]40 Qi Gems for 3 cards[/b], unlimited stock. [/*]
[*]Requires the walnut room to be unlocked (Qi's quest line + 100 Golden Walnuts). [/*]
[/list][b]HOW TO USE[/b]
[list]
[*]Hold the card and [b]right-click an already opened (empty) chest[/b] inside the Volcano Dungeon. [/*]
[*]The chest closes again and its loot is [b]randomly regenerated[/b]; open it again to collect the new items. [/*]
[*]Each reset consumes [b]1 card[/b]; the same chest can be reset infinitely. [/*]
[*]Works on both normal and rare chests (the chest type is detected and refilled through the vanilla logic). [/*]
[/list][b][size=4]IMPORTANT[/size][/b] [b]Note: only right-click a chest after it has been opened to reset it; left-clicking will make the chest disappear.[/b] If the chest has not been opened yet (still holds its items), right-clicking is refused and no card is consumed. [b]INSTALL[/b] Unzip into your Mods folder so that Mods\VolcanoChestResetCard\manifest.json exists, then launch the game through SMAPI. Name, description and messages follow your game language (English / 简体中文). [b]REQUIREMENTS[/b] SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer (Stardew Valley 1.6.x). [b]KNOWN ISSUES / NOTES[/b]
[list]
[*]Only works on chests inside the Volcano Dungeon; use the Skull Cavern Chest Reset Card for Skull Cavern treasure rooms (both mods are safe to install together). [/*]
[*]The card cannot be placed on the ground (placement is blocked). [/*]
[*]Harmony patches Object.placementAction only — very unlikely to conflict with other mods. [/*]
[*]Uninstalling: spend or drop leftover cards first; the mod touches no quest or save state, so removing the folder is otherwise save-safe. [/*]
[/list][b][size=4]姜岛宝箱重置卡（中文版）[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]获取[/b]：齐先生核桃房 [b]40 齐钻换 3 张[/b]，库存无限；需先解锁核桃房（齐先生任务线 + 100 个金核桃）。 [/*]
[*][b]用法[/b]：手持卡片，对着火山地牢中[b]已经打开过（空）的宝箱按右键[/b]——宝箱重新关好并随机重掷战利品，可无限次重置；普通宝箱与稀有宝箱都支持。 [/*]
[*][b]注意[/b]：使用重置卡时应在宝箱开启后右键宝箱才可重置，[b]左键会导致宝箱消失[/b]；未开启的宝箱右键会被拒绝且不消耗卡片。 [/*]
[*][b]安装[/b]：解压到 Mods 目录，使 Mods\VolcanoChestResetCard\manifest.json 存在即可。 [/*]
[*][b]需求[/b]：SMAPI 4.0.0 及以上（星露谷 1.6.x）。 [/*]
[*][b]兼容[/b]：只对火山地牢宝箱生效；骷髅洞穴请用「骷髅洞穴宝箱重置卡」，两者可同时安装。 [/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Volcano Chest Reset Card
Manifest.Description: Adds a card that resets opened treasure chests in the Volcano Dungeon so you can open them again. Sold in Qi's walnut room: 40 Qi Gems for 3 cards. Only right-click an opened chest to reset it.
Manifest.Author: Trae
